Install openai-codex on Omarchy

Codex CLI is OpenAI's lightweight AI coding agent that runs locally on your machine instead of in the cloud. From the terminal you describe what you want built, fixed, or explained, and it reads your codebase, edits files, and runs commands to get it done; it also plugs into editors like VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It needs an OpenAI account to function, either signing in with a ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise plan or authenticating with an OpenAI API key.

Watch: OpenAI Codex CLI ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add openai-codex-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.162.1-1:
    pacman -Qi openai-codex-bin

Open and use openai-codex

openai-codex has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql openai-codex-bin | grep /usr/bin/

openai-codex requirements and compatibility

  • An OpenAI account: either a ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise subscription, or an OpenAI API key with billing enabled
  • Network access to reach OpenAI's servers

Pricing and license

CLI itself is free and open-source; using it requires a ChatGPT paid plan or pay-as-you-go OpenAI API usage. License: Apache.

Uninstall openai-codex

omarchy pkg drop openai-codex-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install openai-codex on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add openai-codex-bin. The download is 129.5 MB and it takes 369.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is openai-codex free?

CLI itself is free and open-source; using it requires a ChatGPT paid plan or pay-as-you-go OpenAI API usage. The package is licensed Apache.

How do I uninstall openai-codex?

Run omarchy pkg drop openai-codex-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does openai-codex depend on?

openai-codex declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is openai-codex a desktop app?

No. openai-codex has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is openai-codex in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as openai-codex-bin (version 0.162.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. OpenAI makes it. Project site: https://github.com/openai/codex.
